question.text: Determine the correct order of hybridization of the central atom in the following species  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> ,  <math><mo>[</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msup><mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> .

solution.text: Hybridization of N in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math>  that of Pt in  <math><mo>[</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msup><mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math>  is  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math>  that P in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></math>  and that of B in  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math>  is <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> .
